Docs.summary: The UTC time at which this stored upgrade insight expires and is removed from the data store (currently `lastEvaluatedAt` plus a 14-day retention window). After this time a GET for the resource returns 404 Not Found and it no longer appears in the list, indicating the caller should call the compute operation to produce a fresh evaluation. Exposing the expiry lets clients decide when to recompute without hardcoding the retention period.

Docs.summary: The UTC time at which this upgrade insight was last computed (the last time the compute operation ran for this resource). This is the resource-level "last run" marker and, for a cached record, indicates how stale the stored evaluation is. For a combined evaluation it is the umbrella run time across all scopes, whereas each scope's `evaluation.evaluatedAt` records when that specific snapshot was produced.
